THE SECOND HAVEN APPROACH

A home. A community.
A chance to begin again.

Second Haven is being developed as a small, nonclinical recovery residence for adults building a life in recovery. The idea is simple: a substance-free home where residents take an active role in the life they share.

Our connection to animal rescue inspired the name—a belief in patience, dignity, and second chances. That same spirit shapes the home we’re working to create.

Get to know the home

THE HOME IN PREPARATION

Thoughtful preparation.
A home to share.

Second Haven is being planned within a three-bedroom, split-level townhome. Repairs and room arrangements are still being completed, and no rooms are currently offered for immediate move-in.

The bedrooms are on the lower level and require stairs. The household shares common living spaces and 1.5 bathrooms, including one shower. Discuss any access needs with JR.

Room options, pricing, furnishings, included amenities, and rental terms will be confirmed before room advertising resumes. Written house expectations and the move-in process are also being finalized.

General questions are welcome. Please contact JR before visiting; an inquiry does not reserve a room or establish a move-in date.

Second Haven is being planned as nonclinical housing. Medical care, detoxification, and treatment services would be provided by outside professionals—not by the house.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Questions are
always welcome.

A few things to know about the home we’re planning.

How will the household be managed?+

The management arrangement, household responsibilities, and written rules are still being finalized. Before any rental agreement, JR will explain how the home will be managed and how residents can raise questions or concerns.

Is Second Haven a treatment facility?+

No. The planned service is nonclinical recovery housing. It does not include detoxification, therapy, medical care, or around-the-clock staff supervision. Residents would arrange any clinical care with outside providers.

Can I inquire now, and when could I move in?+

General questions are welcome, but the home is not yet accepting new move-ins. Repairs and preparation are underway, and no opening or move-in date is confirmed. Text JR at (424) 285-4489 with a question. An inquiry does not reserve a room or confirm admission.

What does a room cost, and what is included?+

Room options, pricing, deposits, furnishings, included amenities, and rental terms will be confirmed before room advertising resumes. No current room offer is published here. Written terms will be reviewed before any agreement or payment. Financial assistance is not currently confirmed.

What are the rooms and access like?+

The home has three bedrooms on the lower level, reached by stairs. Room arrangements are being finalized. Bathrooms and common spaces are shared, with 1.5 bathrooms and one shower. Discuss any access needs with JR.

Where is the house, and can I visit?+

The home is at 2192 4th Avenue East, West Fargo, ND 58078. Contact JR before visiting to discuss viewing options.

How can I make a housing inquiry for someone?+

Call or text JR at (424) 285-4489 for general questions. Please keep an initial inquiry to contact details and your question; do not send medical records by text. The home is not yet accepting placements, and a move-in date has not been confirmed.
